load_bpe_from_hub: use torch.hub to load the fairseq BPEHubInterface for byte-pair encoding text
load_tokenizer_from_hub: use torch.hub to load the fairseq TokenizerHubInterface for tokenizing text
load_pretrained_model: use torch.hub to load a pretrained fairseq model by name from MODEL_REGISTRY
build_cython_components: trigger automatic Cython component build via setuptools sandbox when token_block_utils_fast is missing
inspect_hub_models: list available pretrained model names exposed by fairseq MODEL_REGISTRY hub models
